fusions.name: Hawthorn Pounce
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles to one enemy and rake it for 13 damage. Thorned claws leave it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nepeta Haze
fusions.desc: Shakes out a haze of pollen that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tallgrass Prowl
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 8 health. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Regrowth
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
